Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: matched multiview modeling reference for one fantasy RPG Alarm Clock.
One identical chunky round mechanical twin-bell alarm clock, antique warm brass case with restrained olive patina at physical seams, two large domed bells with a real gap between them and an upright hammer, sturdy angled feet, curved carry handle behind bells. Ivory dial with bold black twelve hour tick marks, dark hands pointing about 7:10, no digits or lettering. Small winding key and a circular access plate on BACK. Clear cream/brass/dark hierarchy readable at 96px. Case is genuinely deep: depth 35 percent of dial diameter. Cast brass bells thick, subtle hammered finish, broad smooth domes and crisp rolled edges.
Produce a strict 2x2 equal-panel atlas of the SAME object. Top left FRONT (-Y); top right RIGHT SIDE (+X); bottom left BACK (+Y); bottom right TOP (+Z). TRUE ORTHOGRAPHIC AXIS VIEWS: front/back/side camera at body midheight, horizontal eye line, no rim seen from above in elevations, NO perspective. Top sees protruding bells, actual depth, rear handle and rear key consistently. Same world scale in every panel, front/back heights aligned. No labels, divider lines, environment, ground, cast shadows, contact shadow or pedestal. Transparent background. Object fits each panel with 12 percent margin. Broad diffuse uniform light, nearly flat albedo illumination, no hot specular reflection or dark vignette. Same wear features/material colors in all views. Match volumes and parts exactly across views; do not invent different clocks. Distinct BACK and deep SIDE are essential, not repeated front art. Square high-resolution reference sheet.

Closed volume, real thickness 22 percent of cover height, covers overhang the page block, slightly bevelled corners. No extra straps, clasps, chains or props. Strong simple graphic hierarchy for a 96px game icon, restrained fine leather texture and visible paper edges.
Strict 2x2 atlas, SAME object in matched orthographic axis views, same world scale. TOP LEFT FRONT from -Y (broad cover face); TOP RIGHT RIGHT SIDE from +X (narrow fore-edge showing actual stack thickness, both blue covers as front/back strips); BOTTOM LEFT BACK from +Y (spine appears on opposite image edge); BOTTOM RIGHT TOP from +Z (narrow actual cover-to-cover thickness, left curved spine, page edges, two cover strips). Front/back upright and camera at midheight; no perspective, no quarter view, no top visible in front/back. Book height and thickness must agree across every view. Keep 12 percent empty margin in each square panel. Transparent background, no cast shadows, no floor, no pedestal. No labels or divider lines. Broad uniform diffuse illumination approaching flat surface albedo, no cinematic light, no broad specular stripes, no dark gradient. All views share identical material colors and structural details. Square high-resolution sheet.
